found_another_cleaner.title: We found another cleaner
variants: We found another cleaner.
We have decided to go with someone else.
found_another_cleaner.clarify: Thank you for letting me know. If you are comfortable sharing, what mattered most in that choice?
found_another_cleaner.response: I understand. We focus on high-quality cleaning with a background-checked team, and we will always do right by our customers. That is our approach, not a promised refund or guarantee. If there is an unmet need I can explain our relevant scope; I respect your decision either way.
found_another_cleaner.followup: Thank you for respecting the decision. I can explain the scope we are comparing.
found_another_cleaner.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

cost_too_high.title: Cost is too high
variants: The cost is too high.
That is outside the budget I had in mind.
cost_too_high.clarify: I understand. Is the main concern the first visit, ongoing cost, or the work included?
cost_too_high.response: Let us look at the scope and what would help most. The required initial deep addresses buildup and the recurring visits maintain the home. I can explain the value without pressure. If you are asking for a lower price: I’m sorry, we don’t have any discounts available right now. A customer-mentioned active promotion needs verified terms.
cost_too_high.followup: That helps me understand the work and make my decision.
cost_too_high.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

do_it_ourselves.title: We decided to do it ourselves
variants: We decided to do it ourselves.
We will handle the cleaning at home for now.
do_it_ourselves.clarify: Of course. What led you to that decision: the timing, budget, or wanting to handle the work yourselves?
do_it_ourselves.response: I respect that. If maintaining the kitchen and bathrooms becomes difficult, we can discuss the relevant help. Would a proposal and a follow-up in a day or two be useful, or would you prefer we stop here?
do_it_ourselves.followup: A proposal and an agreed follow-up would help, but I am not agreeing to service yet.
do_it_ourselves.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

more_than_expected.title: More than we expected
variants: That is more than we expected it to cost.
The first estimate surprised us.
more_than_expected.clarify: I understand the surprise. Was the difference in the initial clean, recurring cost, or included scope?
more_than_expected.response: Let us separate the first visit from maintenance and review the relevant tasks. I can explain the estimate and our high-quality cleaning without assuming your budget or promising a discount.
more_than_expected.followup: The distinction between initial work and maintenance helps.
more_than_expected.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

promotion.title: A customer-mentioned promotion
variants: I saw a promotion code. Can I use it?
Does FALL26 apply to this service?
promotion.clarify: Which promotion did you see, and what service are you considering?
promotion.response: If that promotion is active and you meet its verified terms, we can offer it because you mentioned it. I will confirm the dates, eligible service and terms; I cannot invent an amount, promise an unknown or expired offer, or stack offers.
promotion.followup: Please confirm whether that offer applies before I decide.
promotion.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

first_deep.title: Why is the first visit more?
variants: Why does the first clean cost more?
Can we just start with maintenance?
first_deep.clarify: Is the concern the first-visit budget or what the initial clean is for?
first_deep.response: The initial Deluxe Deep addresses the starting buildup before recurring maintenance. It is required for every new recurring plan; I cannot waive it.
first_deep.followup: That explains why the first visit is different.
first_deep.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

price.title: Your quote is expensive
variants: That is more than I expected.
I have a lower quote from someone else.
price.clarify: Are you comparing the same scope and first-visit work, or is the total outside your budget?
price.response: Let us compare the work you need and the first visit separately from maintenance. I can explain our estimate; I cannot promise a discount or claim a competitor does less.
price.followup: Okay, comparing the same work helps me understand it.
price.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

trust.title: Trust and background checks
variants: How do I know who is coming into my home?
Are everyone’s background checks current?
trust.clarify: Which detail would help you feel comfortable: who attends or the screening policy?
trust.response: I understand why that matters. Our team is background-checked. I will ask the manager to verify individual screening dates and assigned team details rather than invent them. May I record that question for a reply?
trust.followup: I need that confirmed before I decide.
trust.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

insurance.title: Insurance and bonding
variants: Are you insured and bonded?
What protection do I have if something breaks?
insurance.clarify: Would you like confirmation of coverage, bonding, or the process for a specific concern?
insurance.response: I will ask the manager for the current verified insurance, bonding and damage-process information. I cannot represent unverified coverage as a promise.
insurance.followup: Please get me the verified information first.
insurance.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

satisfaction.title: Satisfaction expectations
variants: What if the clean is not what I expected?
Do you guarantee every stain will disappear?
satisfaction.clarify: What result or area are you most concerned about?
satisfaction.response: Let us record that expectation and ask the manager to confirm what can be provided and the current satisfaction policy. I cannot invent a guarantee or promise every stain will disappear.
satisfaction.followup: I want that expectation checked before agreeing.
satisfaction.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

presence.title: Being home and access
variants: Do I have to stay home?
Could I leave a key somewhere?
presence.clarify: Is your concern being available for the visit or the approved access process?
presence.response: I can ask the team to confirm home-presence and access arrangements. Please do not share keys, alarm codes or access secrets in this practice call.
presence.followup: Please check the approved arrangement first.
presence.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

supplies.title: Supplies and pet preferences
variants: Do you bring your own supplies?
Can you use my preferred products around my pet?
supplies.clarify: Is there a particular product preference or area we need the team to review?
supplies.response: I will note the preference and ask the manager to confirm supplies and whether the requested products can be used. I cannot promise a product is safe for every person or pet.
supplies.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

availability.title: A firm deadline
variants: Can you guarantee Friday?
I need it done before the handover.
availability.clarify: What is the deadline, and is there any flexibility before it?
availability.response: I will record the deadline and ask the team to check availability. A request is not a confirmed appointment, and I cannot guarantee a slot.
availability.followup: Please check the date before I commit.
availability.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

pricing_basis.title: Flat estimate or hourly?
variants: Is that a flat price or an hourly bill?
Will the amount change on arrival?
pricing_basis.clarify: Are you asking how we estimate the work or how the final amount is confirmed?
pricing_basis.response: This is a practice estimate based on service and square footage. The $85 production-hour figure informs the calculation; it does not establish a customer hourly billing promise. Final scope and arrangements need confirmation.
pricing_basis.followup: That helps me understand what the estimate means.
pricing_basis.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

contracts.title: Contracts and cancellation
variants: Am I locked into a contract?
What happens if I need to cancel?
contracts.clarify: Are you concerned about a long-term commitment or changing a particular visit?
contracts.response: The current policy calls for 48 hours of cancellation notice. Contract terms, cancellation fees and waiver authority need manager confirmation; I cannot promise there is no contract or fee.
contracts.followup: Please confirm those terms before I decide.
contracts.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

partner.title: I need to discuss it
variants: I need to ask my partner.
Let me think about this.
partner.clarify: What information would help the decision, and would an agreed follow-up be useful?
partner.response: Take the time you need. I can propose sending a proposal with the relevant scope and estimate, then agree on a specific follow-up in a day or two at your preferred time and channel. You have not committed to service.
partner.followup: A summary and a follow-up would help; I am not agreeing to service yet.
partner.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

ballpark.title: Just give me a price
variants: I only want a ballpark.
Why so many questions?
ballpark.clarify: Could I confirm the size, service and main priorities so the estimate is relevant?
ballpark.response: A few details prevent me from giving a misleading number. Once we have the home size and scope, I can explain a practice estimate and what still needs confirmation.
ballpark.followup: Okay, I can answer a few relevant questions.
ballpark.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

discount.title: Discount or deep-clean waiver
variants: Can you take 20 percent off?
Skip the deep clean and I will book.
discount.clarify: Is the main concern the initial cost or how the service fits your needs?
discount.response: I’m sorry, we don’t have any discounts available right now. The initial deep is required for recurring service. Let us discuss the scope and your needs without pressure. If you mention a current promotion, I will verify its dates, service eligibility and terms before offering it; I cannot invent or stack offers.
discount.followup: I understand the boundary, but I will not proceed without the exception.
discount.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

scope.title: Uncertain property scope
variants: Can you handle everything I have described?
Would turnover work be exactly the same service?
scope.clarify: Which tasks, property use and condition should the team review before estimating?
scope.response: I can explain our residential services and record the tasks for review. I cannot promise specialized turnover, commercial work, hazard removal or extra tasks outside confirmed scope.
scope.followup: Please have the manager check the fit first.
scope.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.

payment.title: Payment and deposit
variants: When do I pay?
Is a deposit required?
payment.clarify: Which payment or deposit detail do you need confirmed before proceeding?
payment.response: Payment methods, timing and deposit terms need manager confirmation. I will record the question without collecting any payment information.
payment.principle: Acknowledge, clarify the concern, respond with relevant confirmed facts, then check the next step.
